title: 沉管基床整平
summary: 本課以以海床幾何、接觸壓力與沉陷驗證沉管基床為主線，從溝槽斷面與開挖體積與淨重與基床平均壓力建立系統邊界，再把墊層厚度與材料收支、高點接觸與局部壓力連到基床交接與長期基線。測得平整不代表全部接觸，基床與深部地層的長期變形須分開。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on verify immersed-tunnel bedding through seabed geometry, contact pressure and settlement. It begins with Trench section and dredging volume and Submerged weight and mean bed pressure, links Bedding thickness and material balance and High-point contact and local pressure, and ends with Bedding handover and long-term baseline. Measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查溝槽斷面與開挖體積：V=width*depth*length=40 m*1 m*200 m=8000 m3 for an assumed rectangular layer；再獨立檢查淨重與基床平均壓力：q=netDownwardForce/contactArea=20000 kN/4000 m2=5 kPa。其餘條件不變，壓縮係數由 0.0002 增為 0.0003 /kPa，簡化沉陷由 50 增為 75 mm；相鄰管節差異仍須轉成接頭轉角檢核。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為測得平整不代表全部接觸，基床與深部地層的長期變形須分開。 將核對水位基準、聲速剖面及交叉測線閉合差作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Trench section and dredging volume: V=width*depth*length=40 m*1 m*200 m=8000 m3 for an assumed rectangular layer. Independently check Submerged weight and mean bed pressure: q=netDownwardForce/contactArea=20000 kN/4000 m2=5 kPa. With other inputs fixed, compressibility rising from 0.0002 to 0.0003 per kPa increases simplified settlement from 50 to 75 mm; differences between elements still require joint-rotation assessment. The two results are not a complete design because measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. Use check water-level datum, sound-speed profiles and cross-line closure residuals as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「溝槽斷面與開挖體積」與「淨重與基床平均壓力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Trench section and dredging volume" and "Submerged weight and mean bed pressure": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 溝槽斷面與開挖體積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Trench section and dredging volume: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「溝槽斷面與開挖體積」如何影響沉管基床整平的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Trench section and dredging volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Immersed-tunnel foundation-bed leveling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 海床溝槽需容納管節、基床及回填保護，疏浚體積還受邊坡和原地形影響。矩形體積只是物料帳基準，超挖與回淤會改變後續接觸；應將設計斷面與不同時間海床測量配準，不能只用船舶出土量驗收幾何。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以多期測深斷面比較設計底標高、邊坡及回淤；若出現疏浚完成後回淤未重測，管節落在軟泥而非設計基床，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「溝槽斷面與開挖體積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The trench accommodates element, bedding and protective fill, with slopes and terrain changing dredged volume. A rectangular estimate is only a material baseline; over-dredging and resedimentation alter contact. Register design and time-stamped seabed surveys rather than accepting geometry from vessel spoil volume alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare repeated bathymetry with design base level, slopes and resedimentation. If unsurveyed resedimentation leaves the element on soft mud rather than the designed bed, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Trench section and dredging volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：V=width*depth*length=40 m*1 m*200 m=8000 m3 for an assumed rectangular layer。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: V=width*depth*length=40 m*1 m*200 m=8000 m3 for an assumed rectangular layer.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「出土量達到設計值就能保證溝槽形狀正確」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Design dredged volume guarantees the correct trench shape" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「溝槽斷面與開挖體積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Trench section and dredging volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 溝槽斷面與開挖體積

knowledge.textEn: The trench accommodates element, bedding and protective fill, with slopes and terrain changing dredged volume. A rectangular estimate is only a material baseline; over-dredging and resedimentation alter contact.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：出土量達到設計值就能保證溝槽形狀正確 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.title: 溝槽斷面與開挖體積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Trench section and dredging volume: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「溝槽斷面與開挖體積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Trench section and dredging volume” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：V=width*depth*length=40 m*1 m*200 m=8000 m3 for an assumed rectangular layer。測得平整不代表全部接觸，基床與深部地層的長期變形須分開。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: V=width*depth*length=40 m*1 m*200 m=8000 m3 for an assumed rectangular layer. Measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以多期測深斷面比較設計底標高、邊坡及回淤。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare repeated bathymetry with design base level, slopes and resedimentation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「溝槽斷面與開挖體積」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Trench section and dredging volume", which statement holds?

steps.title: 溝槽斷面與開挖體積：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Trench section and dredging volume: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「溝槽斷面與開挖體積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Trench section and dredging volume” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以多期測深斷面比較設計底標高、邊坡及回淤。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「疏浚完成後回淤未重測，管節落在軟泥而非設計基床」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare repeated bathymetry with design base level, slopes and resedimentation. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Unsurveyed resedimentation leaves the element on soft mud rather than the designed bed. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將以多期測深斷面比較設計底標高、邊坡及回淤列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現疏浚完成後回淤未重測，管節落在軟泥而非設計基床，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare repeated bathymetry with design base level, slopes and resedimentation. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If unsurveyed resedimentation leaves the element on soft mud rather than the designed bed, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：疏浚完成後回淤未重測，管節落在軟泥而非設計基床。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unsurveyed resedimentation leaves the element on soft mud rather than the designed bed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以多期測深斷面比較設計底標高、邊坡及回淤。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「疏浚完成後回淤未重測，管節落在軟泥而非設計基床」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare repeated bathymetry with design base level, slopes and resedimentation. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Unsurveyed resedimentation leaves the element on soft mud rather than the designed bed. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將以多期測深斷面比較設計底標高、邊坡及回淤列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現疏浚完成後回淤未重測，管節落在軟泥而非設計基床，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If unsurveyed resedimentation leaves the element on soft mud rather than the designed bed, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Trench section and dredging volume"?

optionsEn: Compare repeated bathymetry with design base level, slopes and resedimentation.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Root-sum-square of errors eliminates every shared datum bias

steps.title: 溝槽斷面與開挖體積：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Trench section and dredging volume: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「溝槽斷面與開挖體積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Trench section and dredging volume” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 疏浚完成後回淤未重測，管節落在軟泥而非設計基床。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以多期測深斷面比較設計底標高、邊坡及回淤，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unsurveyed resedimentation leaves the element on soft mud rather than the designed bed. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare repeated bathymetry with design base level, slopes and resedimentation to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察以多期測深斷面比較設計底標高、邊坡及回淤；若出現疏浚完成後回淤未重測，管節落在軟泥而非設計基床，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。

quiz.explanationEn: Double-counted buoyancy lowers estimated pressure and mispredicts settlement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「深部壓縮與總沉陷」與「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Deep compression and total settlement" and "Differential settlement and joint rotation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 深部壓縮與總沉陷：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Deep compression and total settlement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「深部壓縮與總沉陷」如何影響沉管基床整平的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deep compression and total settlement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Immersed-tunnel foundation-bed leveling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 平整基床下面的軟弱層仍會壓縮，管節表面施工容差不能代表長期位置穩定。簡化一維沉陷模型使用應力增量、壓縮性和層厚，需區分有效應力和總應力；排水時間與應力歷史會改變實際反應。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將分層地質壓縮試驗與管節水準、孔隙水壓共同比較；若出現只驗收基床表面平整而漏掉深部軟層，長期整體沉降，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「深部壓縮與總沉陷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Weak layers beneath level bedding can compress, so construction tolerance does not establish long-term position. A one-dimensional settlement model uses stress increment, compressibility and thickness, requiring effective rather than indiscriminate total stress. Drainage time and stress history modify actual response. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare layer compression tests with element levels and pore pressure. If surface-level acceptance misses a deep soft layer and long-term settlement follows, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Deep compression and total settlement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：s=mv*dSigma*H=0.0002 /kPa*50 kPa*5 m=0.05 m=50 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: s=mv*dSigma*H=0.0002 /kPa*50 kPa*5 m=0.05 m=50 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「基床表面平整就能證明深部地層不會壓縮」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A level bed surface proves deeper ground cannot compress" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「深部壓縮與總沉陷」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Deep compression and total settlement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 深部壓縮與總沉陷
knowledge.text: 平整基床下面的軟弱層仍會壓縮，管節表面施工容差不能代表長期位置穩定。簡化一維沉陷模型使用應力增量、壓縮性和層厚，需區分有效應力和總應力；排水時間與應力歷史會改變實際反應。
knowledge.textEn: Weak layers beneath level bedding can compress, so construction tolerance does not establish long-term position. A one-dimensional settlement model uses stress increment, compressibility and thickness, requiring effective rather than indiscriminate total stress.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：基床表面平整就能證明深部地層不會壓縮 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A level bed surface proves deeper ground cannot compress Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「深部壓縮與總沉陷」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Deep compression and total settlement" is correct?
options: 平整基床下面的軟弱層仍會壓縮，管節表面施工容差不能代表長期位置穩定。
基床表面平整就能證明深部地層不會壓縮
總平均沉陷很小就代表接頭不會轉動
optionsEn: Weak layers beneath level bedding can compress, so construction tolerance does not establish long-term position.
A level bed surface proves deeper ground cannot compress
Small overall average settlement means joints cannot rotate
quiz.explanation: 平整基床下面的軟弱層仍會壓縮，管節表面施工容差不能代表長期位置穩定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Weak layers beneath level bedding can compress, so construction tolerance does not establish long-term position. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 深部壓縮與總沉陷：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Deep compression and total settlement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「深部壓縮與總沉陷」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deep compression and total settlement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：s=mv*dSigma*H=0.0002 /kPa*50 kPa*5 m=0.05 m=50 mm。測得平整不代表全部接觸，基床與深部地層的長期變形須分開。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: s=mv*dSigma*H=0.0002 /kPa*50 kPa*5 m=0.05 m=50 mm. Measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將分層地質壓縮試驗與管節水準、孔隙水壓共同比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare layer compression tests with element levels and pore pressure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「深部壓縮與總沉陷」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Deep compression and total settlement", which statement holds?
options: 均勻係數相同就代表兩種基床材料性能完全相同

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: s=mv*dSigma*H=0.0002 /kPa*50 kPa*5 m=0.05 m=50 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 深部壓縮與總沉陷：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Deep compression and total settlement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「深部壓縮與總沉陷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Deep compression and total settlement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將分層地質壓縮試驗與管節水準、孔隙水壓共同比較。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只驗收基床表面平整而漏掉深部軟層，長期整體沉降」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare layer compression tests with element levels and pore pressure. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Surface-level acceptance misses a deep soft layer and long-term settlement follows. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將分層地質壓縮試驗與管節水準、孔隙水壓共同比較列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只驗收基床表面平整而漏掉深部軟層，長期整體沉降，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare layer compression tests with element levels and pore pressure. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If surface-level acceptance misses a deep soft layer and long-term settlement follows, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只驗收基床表面平整而漏掉深部軟層，長期整體沉降。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Surface-level acceptance misses a deep soft layer and long-term settlement follows. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將將分層地質壓縮試驗與管節水準、孔隙水壓共同比較列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只驗收基床表面平整而漏掉深部軟層，長期整體沉降，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

quiz.question: 要驗證「深部壓縮與總沉陷」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Deep compression and total settlement"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。

A continuous-looking terrain map proves every point was directly measured
Compare layer compression tests with element levels and pore pressure.

steps.title: 深部壓縮與總沉陷：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Deep compression and total settlement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「深部壓縮與總沉陷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Deep compression and total settlement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只驗收基床表面平整而漏掉深部軟層，長期整體沉降。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將分層地質壓縮試驗與管節水準、孔隙水壓共同比較，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Surface-level acceptance misses a deep soft layer and long-term settlement follows. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare layer compression tests with element levels and pore pressure to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將分層地質壓縮試驗與管節水準、孔隙水壓共同比較；若出現只驗收基床表面平整而漏掉深部軟層，長期整體沉降，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If surface-level acceptance misses a deep soft layer and long-term settlement follows, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「基床表面平整就能證明深部地層不會壓縮」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A level bed surface proves deeper ground cannot compress" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 只驗收基床表面平整而漏掉深部軟層，長期整體沉降。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將分層地質壓縮試驗與管節水準、孔隙水壓共同比較，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。

knowledge.title: 根因確認

quiz.question: 在「深部壓縮與總沉陷」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.instruction: 相鄰管節沉陷不同會使接頭旋轉，平均總沉陷小也可能有較大局部角差。單一管節的端點差除長度是弦傾角；本算例額外假定該管節為剛體且相鄰管節保持水平，才可把弦傾角當接頭相對轉角。一般情況須取接頭兩側斜率差，實際還有彎曲及接頭剪力；應沿縱向保留多點量測而不只記兩岸高程。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐管節比較端部高程、縱向曲率與接頭位移；若出現局部軟區造成端部轉角，密封位移需求被平均沉陷漏判，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Different settlement of adjacent elements rotates joints, even when mean settlement is small. Endpoint difference divided by element length is chord inclination. Only the additional assumptions of a rigid element and a horizontal neighboring element make it relative joint rotation here; otherwise compare slopes on both sides. Bending and joint shear also occur. Preserve multiple longitudinal observations rather than relying on the shore-end elevations alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare end levels, longitudinal curvature and joint movement for every element. If a soft local zone rotates an end and mean settlement misses the seal demand, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. steps.title: 差異沉陷與接頭轉角：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Differential settlement and joint rotation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：chordInclination=settlementDifference/length=20 mm/200000 mm=0.0001 rad; relativeJointRotation=chordInclination only for this rigid element beside an assumed horizontal neighbor。測得平整不代表全部接觸，基床與深部地層的長期變形須分開。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: chordInclination=settlementDifference/length=20 mm/200000 mm=0.0001 rad; relativeJointRotation=chordInclination only for this rigid element beside an assumed horizontal neighbor. Measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐管節比較端部高程、縱向曲率與接頭位移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare end levels, longitudinal curvature and joint movement for every element.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 差異沉陷與接頭轉角：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and joint rotation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Differential settlement and joint rotation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐管節比較端部高程、縱向曲率與接頭位移。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「局部軟區造成端部轉角，密封位移需求被平均沉陷漏判」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare end levels, longitudinal curvature and joint movement for every element. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A soft local zone rotates an end and mean settlement misses the seal demand. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將逐管節比較端部高程、縱向曲率與接頭位移列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現局部軟區造成端部轉角，密封位移需求被平均沉陷漏判，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare end levels, longitudinal curvature and joint movement for every element. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a soft local zone rotates an end and mean settlement misses the seal demand, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部軟區造成端部轉角，密封位移需求被平均沉陷漏判。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A soft local zone rotates an end and mean settlement misses the seal demand. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Compare end levels, longitudinal curvature and joint movement for every element. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A soft local zone rotates an end and mean settlement misses the seal demand. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務

steps.title: 差異沉陷與接頭轉角：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「基床交接與長期基線」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bedding handover and long-term baseline” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將測線覆蓋、誤差、取樣及管節位置索引到同一座標。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「未測區被平滑插值掩蓋，日後沉陷缺少可追溯基準」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Index survey coverage, uncertainty, samples and element position to common coordinates. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Smoothing hides an unsurveyed zone and later settlement lacks a traceable baseline. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將測線覆蓋、誤差、取樣及管節位置索引到同一座標列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現未測區被平滑插值掩蓋，日後沉陷缺少可追溯基準，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Index survey coverage, uncertainty, samples and element position to common coordinates. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If smoothing hides an unsurveyed zone and later settlement lacks a traceable baseline, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未測區被平滑插值掩蓋，日後沉陷缺少可追溯基準。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Smoothing hides an unsurveyed zone and later settlement lacks a traceable baseline. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 基床交接與長期基線：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bedding handover and long-term baseline: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「基床交接與長期基線」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bedding handover and long-term baseline” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未測區被平滑插值掩蓋，日後沉陷缺少可追溯基準。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將測線覆蓋、誤差、取樣及管節位置索引到同一座標，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Smoothing hides an unsurveyed zone and later settlement lacks a traceable baseline. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to index survey coverage, uncertainty, samples and element position to common coordinates to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將測線覆蓋、誤差、取樣及管節位置索引到同一座標；若出現未測區被平滑插值掩蓋，日後沉陷缺少可追溯基準，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If smoothing hides an unsurveyed zone and later settlement lacks a traceable baseline, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「地形圖看起來連續就代表每一點都實際量測過」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A continuous-looking terrain map proves every point was directly measured" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
